data.name: World of Elemental （穿越外星当大拿）
data.detailed_description:
Story Background:

An ordinary person living in the 21st century on Earth is unexpectedly transported by a beam of light to a planet filled with magic and elements. He discover that the local inhabitants are struggling against alien invaders, and it seems he might be the key to resolving the crisis. Joining the native faction to fight the invaders appears to be the only option…

Features:

An indie single-player game

Light strategy card turn-based combat

Random event exploration adventure

Gameplay:

Four races with different talents for unique experiences

Card building with various styles for free combinations

Set equipment to make battles more powerful

Open endings with different choices leading to different paths

Developer’s Note:

The current trial version only includes the content of the first chapter, with random events not yet available, and a large number of system equipment still under construction and improvement.

Although our game still has many shortcomings and faces many real difficulties, please believe that we are always working hard.

If this game can bring you a moment of joy amidst the complexities of secular life, then that is the best reward for us!

data.short_description: World of Elemental is an indie single-player card game. With four major races, different talents and traits, various playstyles, and over 100 pieces of equipment and items, you have plenty of choices. As long as you have enough strategy and wisdom, you will become the hero who turns the tide!
